title: The multilinear forms Cayley graph and the eigenvalue method for tensor codes
summary: The connections between graph theory, and more generally association schemes, and coding theory were established by Delsarte for the Hamming metric and rank-metric codes. The ambient metric space of Hamming-metric codes and rank-metric codes can be seen as Cayley graphs generated by words of weight one. The metrics considered then coincide with the geodesic distances of these distance-regular graphs.
